programs.title: Wind Masters
programs.desc: Of Croatia’s 3,600 miles of glimmering coastline, the most famous stretch is its southernmost region: the Dalmatian Coast, where dramatic limestones cliffs rise from the deep and islands are scattered just offshore.​ In Wind Masters, our team is set to explore the most popular sailing routes and the most beautiful places in the Croatian part of the Adriatic Sea. From the famous city of Dubrovnik, which is the most prominent tourist destination in the Mediterranean, to the beautiful island of Korcula, which will enchant your senses with its ancient history.​ If Croatia have crept onto your holidays’ radar, Wind Masters is perfect for you. This series will offer you a complete Croatian experience. Watch it now on Nautical Channel.​

programs.title: Discovering Sint Maarten
programs.desc: One of the most captivating and curious islands of the entire Caribbean is without doubt Saint Maarten. The island is split into two nationalities while also hosting many more, becoming a hub of diverse excitement where the best of different cultures takes place. This is probably because the northern half of the island belongs to France while the southern side is part of the Kingdom of the Netherlands, something highly uncommon around the world.Experience a 12-meter sailboat race, planes flying 50 overhead on crystal blue watered beaches, long streets filled with cultural fusion and wildlife tours and an underwater helmet-diving excursion by the side of a submarine wreck in Discovering Saint Maarten.Broadcasted on Nautical Channel.

programs.title: Sailing Deejay
programs.desc: Today we are going to visit the Hippie Market at Formentera, famous all over the world for its unique type of creativity. We will be making new friends that will be teaching us about their favourite music styles and, this close to the end, will our two protagonists be getting sentimental? Not without a mojito at the beach first! Let's dive in!

programs.title: Sailing Deejay
programs.desc: Our adventure is coming to an end, but the party never stops! Sam and Max have lived their adventure in Ibiza and Formentera, and have to get back home to show family and friends their new skills. We are sailing one last time and partying until dawn to make the most out of our time in Ibiza.

programs.title: Sail-Ho !
programs.desc: Welcome to the third season of Sail-Ho Croatia!  We have already set sail around the most beautiful and interesting parts of the Croatian coastline, and this time we wanted to go a bit further! In this episode, we'll introduce you to the beauties of Cavtat and Konavle and will visit the unmissable treasure of the region: the pearl of the Adriatic, Dubrovnik.

programs.title: Sail-Ho !
programs.desc: In today's episode, we're taking you to the beautiful island of Korcula, a heaven for sailors in search for perfect bays, clear waters, exquisite wine and a mouthwatering local gastronomy. After visiting Korcula, we will pay a visit to an interesting small Dalmatian town that seems to be carved in a rock and was a known spot for notorious pirates.

programs.title: What Sup
programs.desc: On this week's episode we have comedian and viral  video sensation, Megan Mackay. She is best known for her comedic YouTube makeup tutorial videos, and her videos have been seen by more than 4.5 million people worldwide. Will she have the skills to jump on our paddleboard and take on our challenges?

programs.title: Bol D'Or: The Swiss Do It Better
programs.desc: The Bol D’Or Mirabaud is the most important inland lake regatta in the world. Taking place in Switzerland, a landlocked nation that sits on top of the sailing world with multiple successes whether in the Olympic, Offshore or in Grand Prix Racing formats, and champion of two America’s Cup victories. The race started in 1939 and it is a symbolic race that brings together the best of Switzerland’s sailing tradition.Every year they welcome mono-hulls and multihulls on Lake Geneva, starting in the city of Geneva. More than 500 boats fight each other on this 123 kilometre (66.5 nautical miles) course from Geneva to Le Bouveret and back. It is a national treasure that every summer gathers thousands of spectators to the shores of Lake Geneva and really shows how the Swiss indeed do it better.Watch the race and become one with the beauty of Switzerland’s background, available on Nautical Channel.

programs.title: Kite Masters 2017
programs.desc: Welcome to Kite Masters!The series that flies you around the world, together with the very best athletes from one of the fastest, most extreme and stylish sports: kiteboarding. For some people kiteboarding is a hobby, for others it’s a performance, but for many it’s life.We bring the most passionate athletes experience inside the sport to the screen. We’ll take a look back over all the happenings earlier this season in the extreme world of kiteboarding, and the transformation of the sport on the road to Paris 2024.Follow these pro athletes on their journey to become the best in their fields and their evolution throughout the years. Now available, on Nautical Channel.

programs.title: Kite Masters 2017
programs.desc: Right after Weifang, some of the world's top riders flew to Pingtan for the 2017 IKA TwinTip World Championship, together with 2017 KiteFoil GoldCup - ACT3... and so did Kite Masters. Pingtan is the place where it all started for Kiteboarding in China. The first Kiteboarding School was established in Pingtan's sandy beach, helping develop the sport in every way. Since then, thousands of new riders have joined this exciting sport in China.

programs.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup
programs.desc: Welcome to the Canoe Sprint World Championships 2019 celebrated in Szeged, Hungary! Today there are about 1,200 athletes racing from approximately 98 nations, meaning this is the biggest World Championships canoe sprint racing has ever seen. We're about to witness the fastest paddlers on the planet battle it out for medals, for World Championship glory, and to qualify for their country at the Tokyo 2020 Olympic Games. Enjoy the best moments at Szeged on the 2019 Sprint World Championships.

programs.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup
programs.desc: Szeged in Hungary is the third biggest city in the country and the chosen scenery for the Sprints World Cup. Organisers of the ICF canoe sprint moved heaven and earth to prove an international event in the middle of a global pandemic was possible and safe for all participants. As a result, athletes took part in a splendid competition.

programs.title: H2O Racing: F1H2O World Championship
programs.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM F1H2O World Championship is the flagship series of international single-seater inshore circuit Formula powerboat racing. It attracts up to 20 of the world’s leading drivers from 13 countries who navigate the lightweight, tunnel-hull catamarans reaching speeds in excess of 240km/h on the straights.Watch them race through the water in an epic H20 Racing: F1H20 World Championship that has nothing to envy from land F1, on Nautical Channel.

programs.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship
programs.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM-ABP H20 Racing Aquabike World Championship is the premier international Jet Ski competition that sees elite riders compete on cutting edge equipment in four categories: Runabout, Ski, Ski Ladies and Freestyle. The need for speed is demonstrated on this extreme water sport as athletes plough across the water.

programs.title: Hempel World Cup Series
programs.desc: Launched in 2008, the Sailing World Cup series is the annual circuit for the Olympic elite. Over 2000 of the world's leading athletes that represent 75 nations have competed in the Sailing World Cup. It is open to the sailing classes chosen for the 2020 Olympic events in Tokyo 2020, Para World Sailing classes and Kiteboarding when possible.This top series moves around the world offering spectators with the best in the Olympic sailing world. Competition this year is even tougher as top sailors have been preparing for the Olympics and do not want to start with the wrong foot.Watch the best moments of the Hempel World Cup Series that takes us around the world enjoying top-notch sailing.

programs.title: Eurosaf Championship Tavira
programs.desc: The EUROSAF (European Sailing Federation) Championship will take place in the waters off the Portuguese town of Tavira. The 19 sailing champions of Europe will be crowned in this gathering that has over 150 sailors and more than 100 boats and boards compete against triumph. 14 European countries have sent their best sailors to compete in eight different disciplines, including single-handed and double-handed dinghies, plus sailboards and high performance dinghy. They will compete over the 5-day competition to choose the youth champion of Europe in each of these disciplines. Follow the competition of the future talent of the sailing world as they sail across the waters of Tavira, on Nautical Channel.

programs.title: America's Cup Insight
programs.desc: Welcome to another episode of America's Cup Insight. Today, we are at the heart of the British challenge inside the Land Rover B.A.R. We will discover more about the team, the players and the big family behind the boat. Also, find out how boundaries are changing the game and find out more about the wings of change.Plunge into the action with AC35 Insight.

programs.title: Sailing: The Ocean Race
programs.desc: Welcome to the exciting world of the Ocean Race! If you are a lover of sailing and racing, you can't miss the Nautical Channel's summary programmes of this incredible, high-octane regatta, which takes place over several months across the world's oceans.Follow the most prestigious teams and the most experienced sailors as they compete in a series of legs around the world, in a test of physical and mental endurance that tests their skills and abilities in the most difficult and challenging conditions of the open seas.With our Ocean Race highlights, you can enjoy the thrill of this elite competition from the comfort of your own home, without missing a single detail of the battle for first place.Don't miss out and join us in this adventure at sea!

programs.title: Nautical Adventure In A Landlocked Country
programs.desc: Switzerland: home to the Alps and important water competitions like the Bol d’Or Mirabaud, the most important inland lake regatta in the world. Today it becomes the chosen scenario for this Nautical Adventure in a Landlocked Country. From extreme wakeboarding to canoe polo, we will discover that, despite being located far from the sea, Switzerland has a vibrant nautical scene.Get ready to accompany Nautical Channel’s host, Lucia Metzbauer, as she goes wakeboarding with local Swiss pros, learns about the annual Match Race regatta, tries her hand at Stand-Up-Paddle, and discovers the little known sport of Canoe Polo! This country has much to offer, so don’t miss out on its beautiful scenery that will have you pack your bags to come visit on the first occasion.Nautical Adventure in a Landlocked Country reminds us that water sports can be practiced even in countries that do not border the ocean. An inland fanta-sea for those nautical intrepids that are looking for ways of widening their horizons. Welcome to the Alps.

programs.title: Why Not Whitewater?
programs.desc: Welcome to Dimaro, the Rafting Center Val di Sole. Our story begins in 1982 when a group of adventurers decided to make history by being the first humans to raft down the River Noce. Not only they managed to go down the river against all odds, but they also fell in love with its beautiful landscapes and decided to share it with the rest of the world.Why Not Whitewater? takes us on a journey to the north of Italy to explore the valleys and rivers in the most adventurous ways. From canoening to kayaking and from rafting to hydrospeed, we are set to live an odyssey filled with adrenaline and fun that will leave you wondeing why not white water this summer!

programs.title: Sail-Ho !
programs.desc: Welcome back sailors! In today's episode, we're taking you to one of the most beautiful Dalmatian islands - the island of Brac. Famous for its enchanting small towns that have kept an air of tradition, it also offers a taste of top class gastronomy and is recognized for its white stone that is used for buildings around Croatia and the world.

programs.title: Sail-Ho !
programs.desc: Welcome to Vodice! This is one of the country's tourist centers known for its liveliness and variety of water sports. In this episode, we will be attending the Kornati regattas, exploring the beautiful Jezera on the island of Murter and much more. Come join us on Sail-Ho Croatia!

programs.title: Brilliant Corners Jamaica
programs.desc: The Caribbean is filled with places where tourism is rare or close to non-existent. However, there is so much potential for cultural and water sports tourism, they are called Brilliant corners. Nautical Channel is on a mission to explore the brilliant corners of the Caribbean.Going from Haiti all the way to Jamaica or Barbados, we will dive into these brilliant corners, many of them with no tourism at all. With a sustainable tourism approach, get ready to live a fully local experience on Brilliant Corners Jamaica while we practice water sports, taste the traditional local dishes and talk with the habitants of the area.On this occasion, we venture into Jamaica: the third-largest island of the Greater Antilles and Caribbean, home to famous personalities like Bob Marley or Usain Bolt. Through extreme surf travel and consequent writing and aestheticized by jazz, Sam Bleakley gives a voice to the brilliant corners of this country, revealing the character of the place by getting inside the mind of a coastline as much as people.Immerse yourself in the beauty of the yet to discover areas of the Caribbean, available on Nautical Channel.

programs.title: Flavours Of The Sea
programs.desc: Chef Nikolaos is giving us a well-needed cooking lesson before jumping on board to prepare the recipe he has in store for us. He will also take the time to teach us how to find out whether if a fish is fresh or not before we go on and try the dish with the people from the port. Then, we are meeting with the young Chef Jason, who with only 19 years is the main chef at a 4-star hotel. He is cooking on board our boat, and we are excited to try out his dish.

programs.desc: Of Croatia’s 3,600 miles of glimmering coastline, the most famous stretch is its southernmost region: the Dalmatian Coast, where dramatic limestones cliffs rise from the deep and islands are scattered just offshore.​ In Wind Masters, our team is set to explore the most popular sailing routes and the most beautiful places in the Croatian part of the Adriatic Sea. From the famous city of Dubrovnik, which is the most prominent tourist destination in the Mediterranean, to the beautiful island of Korcula, which will enchant your senses with its ancient history.​ If Croatia have crept onto your holidays’ radar, Wind Masters is perfect for you. This series will offer you a complete Croatian experience. Watch it now on Nautical Channel.​

programs.title: Discovering Sint Maarten
programs.desc: One of the most captivating and curious islands of the entire Caribbean is without doubt Saint Maarten. The island is split into two nationalities while also hosting many more, becoming a hub of diverse excitement where the best of different cultures takes place. This is probably because the northern half of the island belongs to France while the southern side is part of the Kingdom of the Netherlands, something highly uncommon around the world.Experience a 12-meter sailboat race, planes flying 50 overhead on crystal blue watered beaches, long streets filled with cultural fusion and wildlife tours and an underwater helmet-diving excursion by the side of a submarine wreck in Discovering Saint Maarten.Broadcasted on Nautical Channel.

programs.title: Sailing Deejay
programs.desc: Today we are going to visit the Hippie Market at Formentera, famous all over the world for its unique type of creativity. We will be making new friends that will be teaching us about their favourite music styles and, this close to the end, will our two protagonists be getting sentimental? Not without a mojito at the beach first! Let's dive in!

programs.title: Sailing Deejay
programs.desc: Our adventure is coming to an end, but the party never stops! Sam and Max have lived their adventure in Ibiza and Formentera, and have to get back home to show family and friends their new skills. We are sailing one last time and partying until dawn to make the most out of our time in Ibiza.

programs.title: America's Cup Insight
programs.desc: Welcome to another episode of America's Cup Insight. Today, we are at the heart of the British challenge inside the Land Rover B.A.R. We will discover more about the team, the players and the big family behind the boat. Also, find out how boundaries are changing the game and find out more about the wings of change.Plunge into the action with AC35 Insight.

programs.title: Sailing: The Ocean Race
programs.desc: Welcome to the exciting world of the Ocean Race! If you are a lover of sailing and racing, you can't miss the Nautical Channel's summary programmes of this incredible, high-octane regatta, which takes place over several months across the world's oceans.Follow the most prestigious teams and the most experienced sailors as they compete in a series of legs around the world, in a test of physical and mental endurance that tests their skills and abilities in the most difficult and challenging conditions of the open seas.With our Ocean Race highlights, you can enjoy the thrill of this elite competition from the comfort of your own home, without missing a single detail of the battle for first place.Don't miss out and join us in this adventure at sea!

programs.title: Hempel World Cup Series
programs.desc: Launched in 2008, the Sailing World Cup series is the annual circuit for the Olympic elite. Over 2000 of the world's leading athletes that represent 75 nations have competed in the Sailing World Cup. It is open to the sailing classes chosen for the 2020 Olympic events in Tokyo 2020, Para World Sailing classes and Kiteboarding when possible.This top series moves around the world offering spectators with the best in the Olympic sailing world. Competition this year is even tougher as top sailors have been preparing for the Olympics and do not want to start with the wrong foot.Watch the best moments of the Hempel World Cup Series that takes us around the world enjoying top-notch sailing.

programs.title: Eurosaf Championship Tavira
programs.desc: The EUROSAF (European Sailing Federation) Championship will take place in the waters off the Portuguese town of Tavira. The 19 sailing champions of Europe will be crowned in this gathering that has over 150 sailors and more than 100 boats and boards compete against triumph. 14 European countries have sent their best sailors to compete in eight different disciplines, including single-handed and double-handed dinghies, plus sailboards and high performance dinghy. They will compete over the 5-day competition to choose the youth champion of Europe in each of these disciplines. Follow the competition of the future talent of the sailing world as they sail across the waters of Tavira, on Nautical Channel.

programs.title: Kite Masters 2017
programs.desc: Welcome to Kite Masters!The series that flies you around the world, together with the very best athletes from one of the fastest, most extreme and stylish sports: kiteboarding. For some people kiteboarding is a hobby, for others it’s a performance, but for many it’s life.We bring the most passionate athletes experience inside the sport to the screen. We’ll take a look back over all the happenings earlier this season in the extreme world of kiteboarding, and the transformation of the sport on the road to Paris 2024.Follow these pro athletes on their journey to become the best in their fields and their evolution throughout the years. Now available, on Nautical Channel.

programs.title: Kite Masters 2017
programs.desc: Right after Weifang, some of the world's top riders flew to Pingtan for the 2017 IKA TwinTip World Championship, together with 2017 KiteFoil GoldCup - ACT3... and so did Kite Masters. Pingtan is the place where it all started for Kiteboarding in China. The first Kiteboarding School was established in Pingtan's sandy beach, helping develop the sport in every way. Since then, thousands of new riders have joined this exciting sport in China.

programs.title: What Sup
programs.desc: On this week's episode we have comedian and viral  video sensation, Megan Mackay. She is best known for her comedic YouTube makeup tutorial videos, and her videos have been seen by more than 4.5 million people worldwide. Will she have the skills to jump on our paddleboard and take on our challenges?

programs.title: Bol D'Or: The Swiss Do It Better
programs.desc: The Bol D’Or Mirabaud is the most important inland lake regatta in the world. Taking place in Switzerland, a landlocked nation that sits on top of the sailing world with multiple successes whether in the Olympic, Offshore or in Grand Prix Racing formats, and champion of two America’s Cup victories. The race started in 1939 and it is a symbolic race that brings together the best of Switzerland’s sailing tradition.Every year they welcome mono-hulls and multihulls on Lake Geneva, starting in the city of Geneva. More than 500 boats fight each other on this 123 kilometre (66.5 nautical miles) course from Geneva to Le Bouveret and back. It is a national treasure that every summer gathers thousands of spectators to the shores of Lake Geneva and really shows how the Swiss indeed do it better.Watch the race and become one with the beauty of Switzerland’s background, available on Nautical Channel.

programs.title: H2O Racing: F1H2O World Championship
programs.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM F1H2O World Championship is the flagship series of international single-seater inshore circuit Formula powerboat racing. It attracts up to 20 of the world’s leading drivers from 13 countries who navigate the lightweight, tunnel-hull catamarans reaching speeds in excess of 240km/h on the straights.Watch them race through the water in an epic H20 Racing: F1H20 World Championship that has nothing to envy from land F1, on Nautical Channel.

programs.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship
programs.desc: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM-ABP H20 Racing Aquabike World Championship is the premier international Jet Ski competition that sees elite riders compete on cutting edge equipment in four categories: Runabout, Ski, Ski Ladies and Freestyle. The need for speed is demonstrated on this extreme water sport as athletes plough across the water.

programs.title: Sail-Ho !
programs.desc: Welcome back sailors! In today's episode, we're taking you to one of the most beautiful Dalmatian islands - the island of Brac. Famous for its enchanting small towns that have kept an air of tradition, it also offers a taste of top class gastronomy and is recognized for its white stone that is used for buildings around Croatia and the world.

programs.title: Sail-Ho !
programs.desc: Welcome to Vodice! This is one of the country's tourist centers known for its liveliness and variety of water sports. In this episode, we will be attending the Kornati regattas, exploring the beautiful Jezera on the island of Murter and much more. Come join us on Sail-Ho Croatia!

programs.title: Adidas Sickline Extreme Kayak World Championship
Surf The Alps
programs.desc: The ice cold winter of Switzerland, wind, a board and a kite! Welcome to the adventure of winter kiting! Join us as we visit the oldest snowkiting school in the world and admire the action the snowkiting legends put up. All of this on the immense frozen Silvaplana Lake in the middle of the highest peaks of the Swiss Alps.

programs.title: Facing Waves
programs.desc: In this first episode, we dive into the beauty of Wales: the first and only country to have a hiking trail around it's entire coastline. The Snowdonia National Park is a surfers and stand up paddlers paradise for the few who know about it. Stunning seascapes, ancient castles and perfect surf waves. This week on Facing Waves we're Paddling Wales with Dan and Heleen from Big Blue Adventures.

programs.title: Facing Waves
programs.desc: With 1000 miles of coastline and 250 miles of world class beaches, to many people the Dominican Republic is known as a tropical paradise. Pounding surf, ideal beaches and warm raging water. This week on Facing Waves, we're paddling the Dominican Republic. Luke Hopkins takes his stand up paddleboard on an exploratory journey along the coast, through the rivers, and in the surf that surrounds this idyllic scenery. Come join us!

programs.title: Rediscover North America
programs.desc: Six friends decide to cross 12 states on their canoe, embarking on the adventure of a lifetime. From the Gulf of Mexico to the Arctic Ocean, they battled against the current on the Mighty Mississippi, weathered ice and snow, crossed massive lakes, dodged shifting forest fires and shot challenging whitewater, all in a blasting total of 5200 miles. After eight long months, the expedition is ending, but with only 3 canoes, limited provisions and each other’s company along the way, will they be able to make it in one piece? Find it out on Nautical Channel. Awards: Best Adventure Travel Film – Reel Paddling Film Festival 2017. Winner Best Adventure Film – Waterwalker Film Festival 2017. Winner Canoe and Kayak Magazine’s 2016 Expedition of the Year Award.
